title: Cursor footer
description: A panel-coloured footer with five even link columns (a muted heading over plain 14px links on a 30px rhythm), and far below them a bottom row: the copyright and a shield-marked compliance line in muted ink at the left, a three-way light/dark/system segmented pill and a language pill at the right. Two columns on phones, with the bottom row stacked.
notes: the theme and language pills are visual only: wire your own handlers if you need them
up to five columns; phones pair them two by two
name: cursor-footer

props.name: compliance
props.description: the line after the shield, e.g. certifications

props.name: modeLabels
props.description: accessible names of the system / light / dark buttons, in that order

props.name: activeMode
props.description: which of the three looks pressed
